d: We are hiring a licensed CPA for our finance team in Dubai. This on-site role suits a hands-on accountant with strong UAE accounting and tax experience who can own the month-end close and work independently.
⚠️ Please read before applying: We only consider candidates who meet all three of these requirements:
✅ At least 5 years of accounting experience in Dubai: required
q: At least 5 years of accounting experience in Dubai
Strong knowledge of UAE VAT and Corporate Tax
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field
Strong knowledge of IFRS and financial reporting
Experience with ERP systems and accounting software
Close attention to detail and the ability to meet deadlines
r: li

li

li
